name: wOamShadow
desc: the sprite table copied to OAM: Oam_HideUnused walks it as h = $D6 from the low byte [$D880], one entry (4 bytes) at a time; Oam_ClearShadow fills it  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wVramQueue
desc: the VRAM copy queue run by VramQueue_Run (00:1717: records of source, bank, destination, length); always empty: its count $D881 is only ever set to 0 (README, L2 verdicts)  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wOamUsedEnd
desc: the low byte of the first free entry of wOamShadow: Oam_HideUnused hides the entries from there to the end of the page and sets it back to 0  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wVramQueueCount
desc: the end offset of wVramQueue read by VramQueue_Run; the three stores to it store 0 (00:17CB, 00:1872, 00:1B4C), the routine that would add to it (00:16E1, after Joy_Read) is never called  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wLcdcShadow
desc: LCDC as Lcd_SetupInline / Lcd_SetupInlineNoIE set it (first byte of their inline record), written to rLCDC by them and by the VBlank handler (00:1AF7: the block $D882-$D88A goes to LCDC, BGP, OBP0, OBP1, SCX, SCY, WX - 7, WY, LYC), which also latches it in hLcdcShadow for the mid-frame tile toggles  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wScxShadow
desc: the fifth byte of the inline record of Lcd_SetupInline; the LCD interrupt code copies it to rSCX (00:1A29 region)  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wStatShadow
desc: STAT as Lcd_SetupInline sets it (tenth byte of its inline record), written to rSTAT  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wKeyRepeatDelay
desc: the first byte of the inline pair of Keys_SetRepeatInline; Joy_Read reloads the repeat timer $D8DC from it when the held keys change (the wait before the first repeat) ; named as the Japanese ROM names its keys (hKeysHeld, hKeysNew, hKeysNewRepeat, hKeyRepeatDelay, hKeyRepeatPeriod, hKeysPrev, hKeyRepeatCounter) (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wKeyRepeatPeriod
desc: the second byte of the inline pair of Keys_SetRepeatInline; Joy_Read reloads the repeat timer from it after each repeat ; named as the Japanese ROM names its keys (hKeysHeld, hKeysNew, hKeysNewRepeat, hKeyRepeatDelay, hKeyRepeatPeriod, hKeysPrev, hKeyRepeatCounter) (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wKeysHeld
desc: the keys held: Joy_Read reads both halves of rP1 and stores their complement (1 = held); at power-on it holds the boot keys (README, boot conditions) ; named as the Japanese ROM names its keys (hKeysHeld, hKeysNew, hKeysNewRepeat, hKeyRepeatDelay, hKeyRepeatPeriod, hKeysPrev, hKeyRepeatCounter) (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wKeysNew
desc: the keys pressed this frame: Joy_Read stores (held xor previous) and held ; named as the Japanese ROM names its keys (hKeysHeld, hKeysNew, hKeysNewRepeat, hKeyRepeatDelay, hKeyRepeatPeriod, hKeysPrev, hKeyRepeatCounter) (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wKeysNewRepeat
desc: the keys pressed this frame or repeated: Joy_Read stores the pressed keys, or the held keys when the repeat timer $D8DC runs out (the menus read it) ; named as the Japanese ROM names its keys (hKeysHeld, hKeysNew, hKeysNewRepeat, hKeyRepeatDelay, hKeyRepeatPeriod, hKeysPrev, hKeyRepeatCounter) (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wKeysPrev
desc: the keys held the frame before: Joy_Read copies wKeysHeld here first ; named as the Japanese ROM names its keys (hKeysHeld, hKeysNew, hKeysNewRepeat, hKeyRepeatDelay, hKeyRepeatPeriod, hKeysPrev, hKeyRepeatCounter) (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wKeyRepeatCounter
desc: the frames left before the next repeat, counted down by Joy_Read while the same keys stay held ; named as the Japanese ROM names its keys (hKeysHeld, hKeysNew, hKeysNewRepeat, hKeyRepeatDelay, hKeyRepeatPeriod, hKeysPrev, hKeyRepeatCounter) (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wReturnModeB
desc: a mode saved by Mode_SaveReturnD8F2 (b), the mode the print error screen $14 goes back to (Mode14_State01)  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wReturnStateB
desc: its state, saved by Mode_SaveReturnD8F2 (c)  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wReturnMode
desc: a mode saved by Mode_SaveReturnD93D (b) for a later Fade_GoToB  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wReturnState
desc: its state, saved by Mode_SaveReturnD93D (c)  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wKittsCheckTmp
desc: Kitts_CheckAfford copies the Kitt counter here and subtracts the price in BCD (carry = not enough Kitts)  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wPuzzleBoard
desc: the 15 puzzle's board, row by row: the piece in each cell (0-14), 15 the empty cell; solved when it holds 0-15 in order (Puzzle15_IsSolved, tools/kitty_puzzle.py)  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wPuzzleEmptyX
desc: the column of the empty cell (0-3), moved by the slides (core, 2026-11-14)  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wPuzzleEmptyY
desc: the row of the empty cell (0-3)  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wPuzzleKind
desc: the puzzle's picture: 0 a drawing, 1 a photo of the album, 2 the live camera (chosen on the Kitt host's screen $0E:$0A; Mode0F_State02 / 03 / 04, Puzzle15_FadeToState0C)  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wPuzzlePicture
desc: the drawing (0-4) or the photo of the puzzle, from wPuzzleDrawingsDone or Rng_Scaled (Mode0F_State02 / 03)  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wCountTaken
desc: photos taken, 4 BCD digits (Counters_AddTaken); the counters block $DAC9-$DADA is loaded from SRAM $B000 by Counters_Load and stored back by Counters_Store  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wCountErased
desc: photos thrown away, BCD (Counters_AddErased)  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wCountExchanged
desc: photos exchanged, BCD (Counters_AddExchanged)  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wCountPrinted
desc: photos printed, BCD (Counters_AddPrinted)  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wCountReceivedBoy
desc: photos received from a boy's camera, BCD up to 99 (Counters_AddReceived, bit 0 of [$CFFF])  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wCountReceivedGirl
desc: photos received from a girl's camera, BCD up to 99 (Counters_AddReceived, bit 1 of [$CFFF])  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wKitts
desc: the Kitt counter, 6 BCD digits low byte first (SRAM $100A-$100C): Kitts_Add / Kitts_Subtract / Kitts_CheckAfford  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wPrintGameRecord
desc: the apple game's record, compared with the apples caught [$D94F] by PrintGame_ShowResult  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wPuzzleDrawingsDone
desc: the 15 puzzle drawings solved (0-5, saved with the counters): the next drawing, +1 each time one is solved (Mode0E_State0F); at 5 the host offers the photo and the camera (tools/kitty_puzzle.py)  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wIdCard
desc: the ID card record, $12 bytes, loaded from SRAM $AFB8 (bank 1) by Sram_LoadIdCard and stored by Sram_StoreIdCard  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: hMode
desc: the mode, set by Mode_Set; the main loop dispatches on it (README, mode table)  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: hState
desc: the state of the mode, set by State_Set and by each state  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: hMenuMode
desc: the mode a menu item names: the menu cursor objects store it from their 8-byte item record (02:4D83, 02:4EDA, 02:5480) and the menus go there  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: hMenuState
desc: the state a menu item names, stored with hMenuMode  (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wBgpShadow
desc: BGP, copied to rBGP by the VBlank handler; Fade_StepIn / Fade_StepOut write it from wPaletteTarget and wFadeLevel; Lcd_Off clears it (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wObp0Shadow
desc: OBP0, copied to rOBP0 by the VBlank handler, faded like wBgpShadow (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wObp1Shadow
desc: OBP1, copied to rOBP1 by the VBlank handler, faded like wBgpShadow (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wScyShadow
desc: SCY, sixth byte of the inline record of Lcd_SetupInline, copied to rSCY by the VBlank handler (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wWxShadow
desc: WX - 7, seventh byte of the inline record, the VBlank handler adds 7 and writes rWX (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wWyShadow
desc: WY, eighth byte of the inline record, copied to rWY by the VBlank handler; the album text and name card windows slide by moving it (AlbumText_ObjSlideIn / Out, NameCardEdit_ObjSlideIn) (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wLycShadow
desc: the line of the first mid-frame split: the VBlank handler copies it to rLYC and hSplit1Latch; the Stat_Set* routines set it ($4F, $07, ...) (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wPaletteTarget
desc: BGP, OBP0, OBP1 to fade to or from (bytes 2-4 of the inline record of Lcd_SetupInline), read by Fade_StepIn / Fade_StepOut; named as the Japanese wPaletteTarget (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wFadeLevel
desc: two running sums per palette (the colours in bits 0-1 / 4-5 and in bits 2-3 / 6-7): Fade_StartIn clears them, Fade_StartOut loads them from the current palettes, each Fade_StepIn / Fade_StepOut step adds or subtracts a quarter of wPaletteTarget and writes the result to wBgpShadow-wObp1Shadow (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wFadeRunning
desc: 1 from Fade_StartIn / Fade_StartOut until Fade_SetModeFromObject sets the next mode at the end of the fade, then 0 (hand 2026-11-15)

name: hVBlankDone
desc: set to 1 at the end of each VBlank handler; Rst08_WaitVBlank clears it and waits for it (hand 2026-11-15)

name: hFrameCounter
desc: incremented once per frame by the VBlank handler (KeyPrompt_Wait and Puzzle15_ObjTick read it) (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wSlotTagOwnerCopy
desc: the tag of the photo being loaded or stored, first part: Photo_Store copies $DA52-$DAA6 ($55 bytes) to slot offset $F00 and Photo_Load* read it back; the offsets are those of the Japanese tag (wSlotTag*, SRAM slot +$F00-$F54): owner ID $DA52 (4), owner name $DA56 (9, the small glyphs of Text_SmallGlyphAddrDA56), gender / blood type $DA5F, birthday $DA60 (4, Digits_*NibbleTileAddr); named as the Japanese wSlotTagOwnerCopy (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wSlotTagRecvCounters
desc: tag offset $F12-$F14, the Japanese reception counters; CardStats_IncDA64 adds to it (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wSlotTagComment
desc: tag offset $F15-$F2F: the comment, 3 lines of 9 cells, typed and drawn by AlbumText_CursorUpdate / Text_PutCharAt* (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wSlotTagCopyFlag
desc: tag offset $F33 (the Japanese copy flag); Photo_MakeThumbnail / Mode03_State11 write it (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wSlotTagHotspotFields
desc: tag offset $F36-$F53 (the Japanese hotspot fields); only CardStats_IncDA64 points at it (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wSlotTagBorder
desc: tag offset $F54 (the Japanese border number); read by the album objects (Album_ObjLoadSlot, Album_ObjFollowDAA6, Mode03_State04) (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wCardPhotos
desc: the three photos of the name card, 3 x $230 bytes (35 tiles each, $C230 / $C460 / $C690): Mode0B_State05 copies the reduced photo from $C000 into the box [$D980] and to VRAM $9170; saved at SRAM bank 0 $B1FC by Sram_StoreCardPhotos (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wCardBackgroundSel
desc: the background of the name card on screen: NameCard_LoadBackgroundTiles, NameCard_ScriptStartRight and Print_LoadItemPicture take it; Mode0A_State00 loads it from wCardBackground and the card's menu (mode $0A state 2, 06:579A / 06:57C5) stores it back (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wCardBackground
desc: the saved background of the name card (counters block, SRAM $B00E), copied to wCardBackgroundSel by Mode0A_State00 (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wNameCardMade
desc: $FF once the name card is finished (06:5199, then Counters_Store; counters block, SRAM $B011), 0 in a formatted save: at boot 0 clears the card photos (05:41A2, Sram_ClearCardPhotos); with 0, the card item of the option menu opens the card maker (mode $0B state $0F) instead of the card (Mode01_State05); Scratch_PrizeTable picks another prize table once the card exists (hand 2026-11-15)

name: wLinkSenderGender
desc: the last byte of the 4 KiB link buffer: the sender stores byte $0D of its ID card there (06:67F0, 06:6B62; bit 0 boy, bit 1 girl), the receiver reads it to count the photo as received from a boy or a girl (Counters_AddReceived) (hand 2026-11-15)
